title: openai-chat-completions-parity: streaming stability, tool-calls, roles/stop/logprobs, and response formatting
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: bring Redwood's /v1/chat.completions compatibility to parity with OpenAI for streaming stability, tool/function calling, role semantics, stop/logprobs support, and response formatting. This PR addresses multiple interrelated gaps observed in customer integrations and in our own conformance tests. Key changes: 1) Streaming stability: rework the SSE framing layer to avoid partial-chunk flushes on large model responses, add backpressure handling in the stream manager, and expose a configurable stream_buffer_threshold to avoid head-of-line blocking. 2) Tool/function calling parity: implement OpenAI-compatible function call metadata in streaming and non-streaming paths (name/arguments fields), ensure deterministic function selection heuristics match upstream behavior, and add token-accurate tool-call cutover so downstream tools receive complete JSON args. 3) Roles and stop/logprobs: normalize incoming role tokens (user/system/assistant) and preserve role order in responses; implement stop sequence semantics identical to OpenAI (multi-sequence support, earliest-match behavior); wire through logprobs for non-streaming completions and include a best-effort logprobs stream event for streaming responses when available. 4) Response formatting: restructure the compatibility layer to emit "role" + "content" JSON messages that follow OpenAI's schema; ensure function_call objects are nested under message choices appropriately and that finish_reason values (stop, length, function_call) match expected strings. Other: add extensive integration tests, update Python/TS SDK compatibility shims, and document the new behavior in docs/openai-compat.md. Rollout plan: staged rollout by default to 10% of hosted traffic for 48h, canary on Dedicated pools, and feature flag for Private customers. Checklist: [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests; [x] e2e streaming canary; [x] docs updates; [x] SDK shims updated; [x] operational dashboards updated. Related: ENG-2345, PM-910, SUP-4432. Breaking change: none expected; fallback to prior behavior is behind feature flag for the first 2 weeks.
commits: feat(openai-compat): rework streaming SSE framing; fix(streaming): add backpressure handling; feat(function-calls): deterministic function selection + streaming args flush; fix(stop-logprobs): implement earliest-match stop sequences; test: add integration coverage for chat.completions parity; docs: update openai-compat.md
review_comments: Ava Chen: Overall change looks good; please add a unit test covering multi-stop sequences edge case.

release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: improved streaming stability; function/tool calling parity in streaming and non-streaming modes; normalized roles and OpenAI-compatible stop sequence behavior; logprobs support for non-streaming and best-effort streaming; updated SDK compatibility shims and docs; opt-in rollout behind feature flag.
